title: 1721 Prairie matches its 1891 photograph
items: The Dexter house at 1721 Prairie Avenue now matches the 1891 Inland Architect plate seen from the plate's own camera: balustrades on both bows and along the parapets, louvred shutters at the front's windows, iron balconettes at the ground floor, a round-headed window between the bows and the tall chimney at its full height.
